decisions.reason: In 2024 the firm promoted the condenser to its own dedicated page, a visible and growing commitment to a product close to its core air-cooled offer that it would have to justify abandoning.
Like B, this condenser gained its own page in 2024, so the firm's public commitment is increasing and there is no sign of disappointing results that cannot be explained as temporary.
The tube liner supports the firm's announced lifecycle-service and repair strategy and costs little to keep listed, so dropping it would contradict the stated direction for little gain.
This customized air cooler line spans several models, so a large investment has been made in it and it is central to the firm's integrated-solutions positioning.
The tube end repair inserts fit the service and spare-parts business the firm emphasizes, and their low carrying cost and steady listing give management no reason to write them off.
